- **Gibberella reference**: Red/pink mold at ear tip, mostly yellow kernels — doesn't match.
- **Diplodia seed reference**: Tan/brown uniformly discolored mummified kernels with white fungal material — closely matches the test image.
- **Trichoderma reference**: Dark blue-green conidia on yellow kernels — doesn't match.

The test image shows the classic Diplodia Ear Rot presentation: grayish-brown mummified kernels with white mycelium between them, matching the description "White fungal mycelium growing over and between kernels... severely affected ears turn grayish-brown, become lightweight (mummified)."
